notes.title: Demo Hotfix 1.2 & First Major Update: Paths and Voices
notes.content:
We've had an incredible few weeks learning about what everyone's thoughts on the Shoni Island demo are! Utilizing the feedback we've gotten in our community Discord server, we're rolling out another hotfix as well as the first major patch since the demo's launch: Paths and Villager Voices!

[h2]Firstly, check out the notes for Demo Hotfix 1.2:
[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed building menu crash
[*] Puzzle loading/saving fix
[*] Right click destroy/slam conflict bug fix
[*] Building text info missing fixed
[*] fixed not all villagers sleeping/waking up
[*] fixed camera movement continues when pausing/autosaving etc
[*] fixed collision issues with some buildings
[*] fixed constructors not using pickups to construct
[*] fixed farmland destroyed plot not re-placeable/causing a crash on highlight
[*] fixed tree planting (loading/saving not tested)
[*] fixed not all UI hiding on demo end screen
[*] fixed demo final end screen (day 5) still showing password/continuable
[*] added demos for farm view and tree planting
[*] fixed some pickups not spawning on ground
[*] fixed adventurous villager wandering
[*] prevented sleepers from being launched (for now)
[*] fixed demo puzzle 1 blocking villagers
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000215/5cafdc357db7902298714b5bf4c50d6e20b416d6.png[/img]

Now, let's jump straight into the major update!

[h2]Paths[/h2]

Players will not be able to create pathways that villagers can use to get from place to place. To get started making a path:

[list]
[*] LMB to make a point
[*] RMB to undo last point
[*] Spacebar to confirm (takes the last LMB point as the final one)
[*] RMB on a path section to remove that section
[/list]
Just as they can create them, players will also be able to destroy paths by pressing RMB over them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000215/d2df09ebd1c4af93d0f5ebaaffa1adcd6ffe5fdc.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000215/5748a873c3ca0c63a46479a3f54ab177a3840d59.gif[/img]

[h2]Villager Voices[/h2]

Lastly, new voice lines were recorded for villagers, so zoom in to see if you can listen in on a conversation or two next time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000215/dc279afc48b47d24497a9eea16e3041fbad4f4e1.gif[/img]

notes.title: Shoni Island Joins the City-Builder and Colony Sim Fest!
notes.content:
We couldn't be more excited to be a part of Steam's City-Builder and Colony Sim fest for 2025!

If this is your first time ever hearing about Shoni Island, then welcome! The island is a rich environment that various refugees have come to inhabit after things went south where they originally came from. While the villagers have managed to carve out various resources to help them survive, there is still much about the island that they do not know about.

The demo gives you a little over an hour of gameplay in a demo-specific scenario! You'll meet our wonderful narrator, Howard, and if you get far enough, you might encounter one of the four elemental faeries that also inhabit the island!

The Shoni Island demo will stay up and available for players to enjoy well after the event. We really hope you enjoy it and for any feedback, we would love you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/4h3VVqDnyM]community Discord server[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000215/435bb9184fe8188d17fcec1b66e24b8f40b76f3f.png[/img]

notes.title: Shoni Island's Demo is Available Now
notes.content:
The demo for Shoni Island is finally here, and I'm honestly both terrified and excited to see what everyone thinks of it.

Step into an immersive, hour-long demo experience that drops you right into the heart of the game! Harness the power of the god hand, shape the fate of your settlement, and uncover the secrets of survival. But the real highlight? Meeting the island’s most peculiar resident: Howard!

We would also really appreciate it if you could join [url=https://discord.gg/4h3VVqDnyM]our community Discord server[/url], where we update players on the game itself and even provide them with exclusive access to extra parts of the demo.

Thank you so much for your support, and get ready for a hands-on adventure unlike any other!

- Sean, Shoni Island Lead Dev

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000215/9d04837110ad4ce0d35c89a72ecca64b47249620.png[/img]

notes.title: The Indie Diarist Podcast Guest: Sean Menzies
notes.content:
Golden Horde Studios founder Sean Menzies sat down with The Indie Diarist to talk about the indie game studio's upcoming title, Shoni Island!

"In this episode, I spent some time with Sean Menzies, founder of Golden Horde Studios, who's working on a cosy sim / resource management game called Shoni Island. Our chat covered anything from the state of industry to the legacy of legendary god game Black & White, and I enjoyed every minute of it! Hope you like it! 🎒💛"

[h3][url=https://open.spotify.com/episode/44Fq7U9o2eBAythLaQKsxm]Check out the full episode on Spotify!
[/url][h3]

[previewyoutube=IK6s4cbCW5w;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog - Features Series Episode 4: Entetainment
notes.content:
Welcome to the fourth episode of Shoni Island's groundbreaking features!

In this episode, Sean goes over what the villagers consider to be entertainment, including different kinds of buildings. These buildings help breathe life into the island and help give character to your village. You can even go as far as unlocking an conservatory!

Look forward to more devlogs about the various features you'll be able to experience in-game when Shoni Island launches in early access on March 15, 2025.

[previewyoutube=eSV3rQsmBhY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog - Features Series Episode 3: Villager Stats
notes.content:
Welcome to the third episode of Shoni Island's groundbreaking features!

In this one, Sean talks about the various skills that different villagers have and how they can use them to help survive the island. Villagers can also socialize with one another to be and stay happy in order to build relationships and get things done!

Look forward to more devlogs about the various features you'll be able to experience in-game when Shoni Island launches in early access on March 15, 2025.

[previewyoutube=kJm7MoejpzI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog - Features Series Episode 2: Personality, Skills, and Tasks
notes.content:
Welcome to the second episode of Shoni Island's groundbreaking features!

This time, we go over the different personalities that the islanders can have as well as what kind of tasks they can perform based on skill. Lead Developer Sean Menzies briefly overviews the different tasks you can perform and how they can help you grow your settlements!

Look forward to more devlogs about the various features you'll be able to experience in-game when Shoni Island launches in early access on March 15, 2025.

[previewyoutube=MKQzEWKWOqU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog - Features Series Episode 1: God Hand
notes.content:
Welcome to the launch of Shoni Island's groundbreaking features!

In this debut episode, we unveil one of the most thrilling tools at your disposal: the God Hand. As the physical extension of your divine will, the God Hand lets you shape, manipulate, and control the world with unmatched power and precision. Dive in and discover the limitless possibilities that come with wielding the power of a god!

Look forward to more devlogs about the various features you'll be able to experience in-game when Shoni Island launches in early access on March 15, 2025.

notes.title: New Early Access Release Date
notes.content:
Thank you so much to everyone who has wishlisted [u][b]Shoni Island[/b][/u] these last few months.

We are so close to 600 wishlists, and we couldn't be more excited to see how many we end up with when the game finally launches in early access.

That being said, there will be a change to the early access date.

Instead, Shoni Island will launch in early access on

✨[h3]March 15, 2025[/h3]✨

Why? Well, we just needed some more time to polish some things and fix a few bugs before we felt reading for Shoni Island to be ready for the world.

We thank you for your patience, and we can't wait to see you in March!
